text.KredimGeldi açık rıza metni: işlenen kiş: KredimGeldi Explicit Consent Statement: types of personal data processed, collection methods, purposes of use and sharing.
text.Hangi kişisel verilerinizi, hangi yöntem: In this statement, you can find which of your personal data we process, by which methods and for which purposes.
text.Topladığımız Kişisel Bilgilerin Türleri: Types of Personal Information We Collect
text.Kişisel Verilerin Kullanım Amaçları: Purposes of Use of Personal Data
text.Kişisel Verilerin Açıklanması ve Paylaşı: Disclosure and Sharing of Personal Data
text.360Dijital (\"Şirket\") olarak, “Veri So: As 360Dijital (the "Company"), in our capacity as the “Data Controller,” we ensure that your personal data specified below is processed, protected, stored, shared and, where necessary, transferred abroad within the scope of the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK), and we take all necessary measures in this regard.
text.Şirketimiz, aşağıda tablo halinde belirt: Our Company processes the types of personal data listed in the table below within the scope of our legal relationships, for the relevant purposes and in compliance with KVKK.
text.Ad, Soyad, Doğum tarihi, T.C. Kimlik Num: First name, last name, date of birth, Turkish ID Number (TCKN)
text.Telefon numarası, e-posta adresi, ikamet: Telephone number, email address, residential address, MERNİS (Central Population Administration System) record
text.Çalıştığı şirket, çalışma şekli, meslek,: Employer, type of employment, occupation, education level
text.Banka hesap bilgileri, kredi kartı bilgi: Bank account information, credit card information, salary range, bank through which salary is paid, down payment amount, other documentable income, loan amount, loan payments, credit card limit and debts, purpose of credit card use, sector information, loan application results, financial score
text.Başvuru formu doldurma tarihi, alınan/al: Date of filling in the application form, offers received/not received, membership date, frequency and dates of logging in to the site, IP address, browser information, social media accounts, on-screen movements
text.Kişisel verileriniz, Şirketimize doğruda: Your personal data is obtained through the information you provide directly to our Company, data collected during your use of the website, mobile application activity and third-party sources.
text.Toplanan kişisel verileriniz, başta yasa: Your collected personal data is processed primarily for the purposes of fulfilling our legal obligations, providing our services, conducting marketing and communication activities, responding to customer requests, improving business processes and performing analyses.
text.Kişisel verileriniz, KVKK ve ilgili mevz: Your personal data may be disclosed or transferred to our business partners, suppliers and legally authorized institutions in cases permitted under KVKK and the relevant legislation. Furthermore, it is ensured that the third parties to which data is transferred take the necessary data security measures.
text.Kişisel verileriniz, KVKK hükümleri kaps: Your personal data may be transferred to third parties abroad, within the scope of the provisions of KVKK, on the basis of legitimate interests that do not harm the fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject, or as required by contract.
text.Kişisel verilerinizin güvenliğini sağlam: Physical, technical and administrative measures are taken to ensure the security of your personal data, and it is protected against data loss, unauthorized access, unlawful data processing and similar risks.

html.Kişisel veri talepleriniz, haklarınız ve: For your personal data requests, your rights and other questions, you may contact us at info@kredimgeldi.com or via our telephone number.
